column1: # Last real data refresh: 2026-08-20 — FFIEC CDR REST/JWT, Schedule RI-B Part II (ACL roll-forward), 14 matrix-cohort banks x 12 contiguous quarters = 168 bank-quarters, ALL at the primary. PURPOSE: base-rate CO/provision after FLG-desk's 14.6x reading, at DAEDALUS's request — the question was whether 14.6x is unusual. IT IS: 99th percentile, and the ENTIRE >=10x tail in 168 bank-quarters is FLG's own two 2026 quarters. COHORT NORM: median CO/prov = 1.00x — banks provision almost exactly what they charge off. p75 1.31 / p90 1.63 / p95 2.00. ⚠️ RIAD FIELDS ARE YEAR-TO-DATE and reset each 31 Dec; the ratio is valid at any quarter because BOTH legs are YTD, but LEVELS are not quarterly flows. ⚠️ IDENTITY TIE RATE: only 127/168 = 75.6% satisfy begin+recov+prov-CO==end; the rest carry RIADC233 adjustments / M&A. FLG ties 6/12 = 50%, an OUTLIER (worst: WAL 3/12, CUBI 5/12). ⚠️ provision <= 0 (a true RELEASE) occurs 2/168 = 1.2%, ZION only. CADENCE: QUARTERLY alongside the MI3 + NDFI cohort screens, next due 2026-11-07; JWT expires 2026-11-05. Scheduled, not event-driven. Reproduce: AGENTS/REGINALD/scripts/mi3_cohort_screen.py machinery, RSSDs from COHORT. ⚠️ ⚠️ READING THIS FILE: the Quarter column is M/D/YYYY and MUST BE PARSED, NOT SORTED — lexicographic sort puts '12/31/2023' before '3/31/2024' and silently reorders the series. DAEDALUS hit this recomputing off this file (got 27.0% and a 2-quarter streak vs the true 42.8% and 6-quarter streak) and caught it only because the printed order could not be chronological. Sort on parsed dates.
